crossRefs.note: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.
Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.
Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor…
For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they will no longer be mentioned by name.
It will come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land…

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
translations.bsb: Isaac reopened the wells that had been dug in the days of his father Abraham, which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham died. And he gave these wells the same names his father had given them.
